description:
Natural Geode Specimen Lot - 7 Pieces
Quartz Crystal Mineral Specimens
Rough Natural Formations
This collection features seven natural geode and crystal specimens displaying varied geological crystalline formations. Geodes form within hollow cavities of sedimentary or volcanic host rock through mineral-rich precipitation over geologic time. This lot showcases diverse textures, hollow vugs lined with sparkling quartz druse, and rugged weathered exterior rinds ideal for geological study, education, or natural specimen display.
Items Included:
Large open geode half with prominent central cavity of quartz crystals
Open geode specimen displaying deep crystal-lined hollow pocket
Natural crystalline cluster fragment with exposed quartz points
Rounded geode nodule with textured outer host rock matrix
Miniature hollow geode with druzy crystal interior
Matrix rock specimen section with exposed crystalline pocket
Geode half featuring translucent to white quartz crystal cavity lining
Condition:
Natural geological specimens in rough, raw condition. All pieces retain their natural mineral surfaces, crystalline formations, and outer matrix without modern lapidary polishing. Natural earth dust, minor fracturing, and rough exterior edges inherent to raw mineral specimens.

Large matrix plate featuring microcrystalline druzy pockets and earthy mineral tones

description:
Natural Mineral Specimen Lot - 6 Pieces
Rough Raw Rocks & Crystals
Natural Geological Specimens
This collection features six individual rough mineral and rock specimens displaying natural crystal formations, cleavage planes, and varied mineral compositions. Unpolished and in their raw geological state, these specimens showcase distinct structural textures, crystalline faces, and matrix host rock ideal for study, educational display, or lapidary collection.
Items Included:
Large crystalline specimen with striated cleavage faces and matrix rock
Angular blocky mineral chunk with visible crystalline surface texture
Triangular crystal fragment featuring distinct cleavage planes and mineralized edge
Compact rough rock specimen with crystalline inclusions
Flat rock fragment showing foliated mineral texture
Pale quartz or calcite rough chunk with translucent mineral planes
Condition:
All six specimens are in authentic, raw, unpolished condition with natural rough edges, surface fractures, and matrix inclusions as found. Light natural mineral dust present. No artificial polishing, cutting, or repairs detected.

condition. Items are represented to the best of our ability,

TESTING:
All of our jewelry offerings are tested prior to going to auction. We use a Thermo Scientific Niton DXL Metal Analyzer to test for precious metals and or JSP Acid Solution Testing in conjunction with the aforementioned analyzer.

description:
You are purchasing a "Mixed Crystal and Mineral Specimen Lot with Amethyst and Quartz" in "Used" condition.
Beautiful mixed lot of natural crystals and mineral specimens, perfect for collectors, crystal healers, crafters, or anyone who loves unique stones. This assortment includes a variety of clear and smoky quartz points, polished and raw amethyst pieces, geode and agate slices, small clusters, and rough matrix specimens. The largest amethyst cluster is a striking display piece, and several of the quartz points are substantial in size, making them great for altars, decor, grids, or photography props. The collection offers a nice range of textures and shapes: from polished wands and points to raw, sparkly clusters and rugged matrix. Ideal as a starter collection, to resell individually, or to add depth and interest to an existing crystal display. Please note: this listing is for the entire lot shown together, including multiple individual stones and clusters in varying sizes. Keywords: crystal lot, mineral collection, quartz points, amethyst cluster, geode slice, agate slice, raw crystals, polished crystal, metaphysical decor, altar stones, specimen lot
Condition Notes:
Lot of assorted crystals and mineral specimens including clear quartz points and clusters, amethyst points and clusters, geode halves, small tumbled pieces, and rough matrix stones. Surfaces show natural inclusions, internal fractures, and variations in color typical of mineral specimens. Some edges and tips have minor chips and rough spots. Matrix pieces have uneven, rough backs with natural pitting and texture. Overall presents as a mixed collection of display and healing stones with normal handling and storage wear.

When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.

.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

shipping.policy:
We are NOT responsible for packages lost, stolen, or damaged in transit. You will need to handle your own claims through the associated shipping carrier. We can provide necessary documentation if requested.
Items from our location will ship within 5-7 business days from the time payment is received. Our hours of operation are Monday through Friday from approximately 7am-3pm EST.
Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
All other items may be combined for payment and shipping if they are from the same Goodwill location, close within 7 days of each other, are not marked as Cannot Be Combined For Shipping, do not exceed 20 lbs in combined weight and are being shipped via the same carrier.
To combine eligible auction items into one order, you must wait until all of the items have ended before paying.
Once the auctions have ended, please sign into your ShopGoodwill.com account and proceed to your Open Orders. Click on the Pay link next to one of the items, all auction items that may be eligible for combination will then be displayed. Click on the box next to each item and follow the instructions to complete your payment.
Once payment has been made for an item, it cannot be combined with another item won at a later date. If you have won an item and expect to win another from the same seller and wish to combine all items, you must postpone payment until you have won the second item (third, fourth item, etc.) but not exceeding 7 days from the closing date of the first item.
Due to the fragility and size and/or weight of certain items, the seller may not offer combined shipping for certain items. Please be sure to read all item descriptions carefully for any other item combination restrictions.
Items that have been paid for will be shipped to the address on file and will not be able to be modified or combined. Address changes, shipping cost adjustments, and/or alternative packaging requests MUST be submitted prior to payment. PO Boxes can be added to your profile address if one of our shipping carriers does not deliver to your physical address. We cannot edit profiles; please be sure this is done prior to making any purchases. Alternative packaging requests are subject to an additional fee where applicable.
In the event of an unclaimed pickup order, or a returned package, the customer will need to pay an additional shipping charge to re-ship the order. Under NO circumstances will a refund be given for said unclaimed/returned packages.
Any and all changes/adjustments MUST be made PRIOR to payment! Adjustments WILL NOT be made after a payment has been submitted. This location is closed on weekends & holidays. We may not be able to get to your support ticket right away. Please plan in advance.

description: This listing is for a multipack of TDK EHG (Extra High Grade) Precision Camcorder Tapes, model TC-30. These VHSC cassettes feature Super Avilyn Technology Plus for improved recording quality. Each tape is designed for camcorder use and labeled with Sound & Color for enhanced audio and video performance. The tapes are new and sealed in original retail packaging, which is black, gold, and red with clear TDK branding. Packaging includes a promotional Kmart gift check offer on the back.

We are NOT responsible for packages lost, stolen, or damaged in transit. You will need to handle your own claims through the associated shipping carrier. We can provide necessary documentation if requested.

Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
All other items may be combined for payment and shipping if they are from the same Goodwill location, close within 7 days of each other, are not marked as Cannot Be Combined For Shipping, do not exceed 20 lbs in combined weight and are being shipped via the same carrier.
To combine eligible auction items into one order, you must wait until all of the items have ended before paying.
Once the auctions have ended, please sign into your ShopGoodwill.com account and proceed to your Open Orders. Click on the Pay link next to one of the items, all auction items that may be eligible for combination will then be displayed. Click on the box next to each item and follow the instructions to complete your payment.
Once payment has been made for an item, it cannot be combined with another item won at a later date. If you have won an item and expect to win another from the same seller and wish to combine all items, you must postpone payment until you have won the second item (third, fourth item, etc.) but not exceeding 7 days from the closing date of the first item.
Due to the fragility and size and/or weight of certain items, the seller may not offer combined shipping for certain items. Please be sure to read all item descriptions carefully for any other item combination restrictions.
Items that have been paid for will be shipped to the address on file and will not be able to be modified or combined. We cannot edit profiles; please be sure this is done prior to making any purchases. Alternative packaging requests are subject to an additional fee where applicable.
In the event of an unclaimed pickup order, or a returned package, the customer will need to pay an additional shipping charge to re-ship the order. Under NO circumstances will a refund be given for said unclaimed/returned packages.
Any and all changes/adjustments MUST be made PRIOR to payment! Adjustments WILL NOT be made after a payment has been submitted. This location is closed on weekends & holidays. We may not be able to get to your support ticket right away. Please plan in advance.
